# projectops

> GitHub project automation template and installer CLI: versioning, release notes, CI/CD, issue automation and agent skills. Install into an existing repo with `npx projectops`.

Ask the tool instead of reading docs: `npx projectops --mode options --json` prints every CLI flag and every version.yml option with allowed values and defaults. `npx projectops --mode doctor` diagnoses an existing install (read-only).

## Start here
- [README](https://github.com/Cassiiopeia/projectops/blob/main/README.md): what it does and the 30-second start
- [Agent instructions](https://github.com/Cassiiopeia/projectops/blob/main/AGENTS.md): rules for agents using or changing this repo, skill routing
- [CLI reference](https://github.com/Cassiiopeia/projectops/blob/main/docs/en/cli.md): flags, modes and examples (English)
- [Getting started](https://github.com/Cassiiopeia/projectops/blob/main/docs/en/getting-started.md)
